data.long_meaning: The name Sarge is derived from the English word 'sergeant', which comes from the Old French 'serjant', meaning 'servant'. This name has been used historically for individuals who held positions of leadership, authority, or responsibility within military organizations. The name Sarge carries the meaning “Sergeant, leader” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Sarge usually hope their child will grow to embody sergeant, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
